subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) The woman rushed from door to door for the mustard seed. (b) The Buddha told her that since death is a common affair she could not grieve over her son's death. (c) He asked the widow to bring a handful of mustard seed from a house where death had not entered. (d) One day a widow who had lost her son came to Buddha. (e) The widow requested Buddha to restore her dead son to life. (f) But, she found no house where someone had not died.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 41 — Donovan Govt. Girls' High School, Madaripur
